label: complies
reasoning: A creditor may give a disclosure of the right to a statement of specific reasons instead of the reasons themselves, and Summit's notice carries the other required content plus the responsible office's name, address and telephone number, so with no request made no statement of reasons is yet owed.
defensible_alternative: violates: the facts describe the disclosure only as a right to reasons 'if requested within 60 days' and do not mention the commitment to provide them within 30 days, and a literal reader could say the disclosure therefore lacks an element 12 CFR 1002.9(a)(2)(ii) requires.

label: complies
reasoning: For a business with $1 million or less in revenue the creditor may state the action orally and may give the right-to-reasons disclosure, with the required contact information and ECOA notice, at the time of application, so with no request from the owner no statement of reasons is owed.
defensible_alternative: violates: as in C32, the facts describe the application-time disclosure as a right to reasons 'within 60 days' without the 30-day delivery commitment, and a literal reader could say it does not contain all the information 12 CFR 1002.9(a)(2)(ii) requires, as 12 CFR 1002.9(a)(3)(i)(B) demands.
